address: East Avenue, Killarney, V93 CF30, Ireland
bio: On the ground floor of the privately-owned Killarney Park Hotel is this elegantly dressed restaurant which comes with ornate cornicing and warm lighting. An oval-shaped cocktail bar sits at one end of the room – perfect for a pre dinner drink – while the horseshoe-shaped booths are the best seats in the house. The kitchen focuses its attention on quality produce from the county, with dishes that give the main ingredients the space to shine. If there's a pasta dish on the menu, be sure to order it....
